# secobserve_license_policy (Resource)

A license policy: a named set of allow/forbid/review rules (`secobserve_license_policy_item`) applied to a product's or product group's components.

~> **Do not manage the seeded `Standard` policy with this resource.** It is created once, on an empty database, as a starting point -- adopting it into Terraform is possible via import, but there is nothing special protecting it from concurrent manual edits the way there would be for a Terraform-only resource. Prefer declaring your own policy.

~> If the provider's token is not a superuser, creating this resource implicitly makes that identity a manager member (`is_manager = true`); declaring a `secobserve_license_policy_member` for the same user then fails as a duplicate. Run the provider as a superuser to avoid this.

~> **`parent` is limited to one level of nesting.** SecObserve rejects assigning a parent that itself has a parent, assigning a parent to a policy that already has children, and assigning a policy as its own parent -- all as a 400 at apply time; the provider does not duplicate these checks at plan time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secobserve_license_policy" "default" {
  name        = "Company default"
  description = "Baseline policy applied to every product unless overridden"

  # Container base images are scanned separately; don't flag their licenses here.
  ignore_component_type_list = ["docker"]
}

resource "secobserve_product" "checkout" {
  name           = "checkout-service"
  license_policy = secobserve_license_policy.default.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the license policy. Globally unique.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `ignore_component_type_list` (Set of String) Package URL types this policy skips entirely, for example `docker` to exempt container base images. Any of `alpm`, `apk`, `bitbucket`, `bitnami`, `cargo`, `cocoapods`, `composer`, `conan`, `conda`, `cpan`, `cran`, `deb`, `docker`, `gem`, `generic`, `github`, `golang`, `hackage`, `hex`, `huggingface`, `luarocks`, `maven`, `mlflow`, `npm`, `nuget`, `oci`, `pub`, `pypi`, `rpm`, `qpkg`, `swid`, `swift`.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether every authenticated user can see this policy, not just members.
- `parent` (Number) Id of the parent policy, if any. See the one-level-of-nesting note above.

### Read-Only

- `has_authorization_groups` (Boolean) Whether this policy has at least one authorization group member.
- `has_items` (Boolean) Whether this policy has at least one item.
- `has_product_groups` (Boolean) Whether at least one product group uses this policy.
- `has_products` (Boolean) Whether at least one product uses this policy.
- `has_users` (Boolean) Whether this policy has at least one user member.
- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the license policy.
- `is_manager` (Boolean) Whether the provider's identity is an explicit manager member of this policy. A superuser can write this resource regardless of this flag, so it reads `false` for a superuser-created policy with no membership rows of its own.
- `is_parent` (Boolean) Whether at least one other policy has this one as its parent.
- `parent_name` (String) Name of the parent policy, or empty if there is none.
